THE WORKSHEET LIBRARY

Printable worksheets for little hands.

One hundred ninety-six printable activities — the paper twins of our games: tracing guides with the same strokes, counting rows, coloring outlines, sound sorts with parent scripts, and science labs with a grown-up answer line — plus the Life Skills & Good Habits sheets, the Community Helpers, Weather & Seasons and Animals & Their Habitats collections and the toddler Matching & Sorting set your child can also solve on screen. Download a real PDF, print straight from the page, or play the matching activity online.

Every worksheet prints on A4 or US Letter. Each sheet’s page keeps everything in reach: the artwork, the download and print buttons, and a place for families to react and comment.

FOR GROWN-UPS

How the library works.

Each worksheet belongs to a class on the Learning Path. The page for every worksheet shows its artwork, a Download Worksheet button (a real PDF file) and a Print Worksheet button that opens the same PDF ready to print — never the website around it.

Downloading or printing never marks anything complete in My Classroom — worksheets are for tables, kitchens and fridge doors. Only the games save progress, and only for the child chosen there.
